clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, Lelanai cares for the night elves’ saber mounts in the Cenarion Enclave. She offers nightsabers and swift war beasts to her kin and trusted allies of the city.

Lelanai tends the great cats of Kalimdor in the Cenarion Enclave, beside riding instructor Jartsam. Night elves have long bonded with the fierce predators of northern forests. They train nightsabers and frostsabers to carry sentinels and scouts across rugged ground with a predator’s grace. In the capital, Lelanai provides these mounts to riders.

Lelanai offers saber mounts to night elves with the proper skill, while outsiders face a higher bar. The cats are sacred to the kaldorei, who keep their distance from strangers. She entrusts a mount to a non-night elf only when they have earned the highest respect and renown with Darnassus.
